pages.quiz:
GERMAN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does "der Himmel" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. snow
   B. weather
   C. sky
   D. rainbow

2. Which article follows "in" for "die Küche"? (1 mark)
   A. der
   B. die
   C. dem
   D. das

3. What does "die Zwiebel" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. watermelon
   B. onion
   C. egg
   D. fish

4. What does "das Wasser" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. water
   B. banana
   C. bean
   D. tea

5. Which form completes "Ich ___ neun Jahre alt"? (1 mark)
   A. bin
   B. bist
   C. ist
   D. sind

6. Which little word goes with the noun "Schrank"? (1 mark)
   A. der
   B. den
   C. die
   D. das

7. What does "Auf Wiedersehen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. good morning
   B. yes
   C. see you soon
   D. goodbye

8. Which form completes "Wir ___ Geschwister"? (1 mark)
   A. bist
   B. sind
   C. bin
   D. ist

9. Which German word means "September"? (month) (1 mark)
   A. November
   B. August
   C. Juni
   D. September

10. What is the plural of "die Wolke"? (1 mark)
   A. die Wolker
   B. die Wolke
   C. die Wolkes
   D. die Wolken

11. Which form completes "Äpfel ___ gesund"? (1 mark)
   A. bin
   B. bist
   C. ist
   D. sind

12. Which German word or phrase means "Friday"? (1 mark)
   A. der Montag
   B. der Mittwoch
   C. das Wochenende
   D. der Freitag

13. Which day comes right after Donnerstag? (1 mark)
   A. Sonntag
   B. Freitag
   C. Mittwoch
   D. Dienstag

14. How is "j" pronounced in "ja"? (1 mark)
   A. like ch
   B. like y
   C. like zh
   D. like j in jam

15. What does "der Käse" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. cheese
   B. juice
   C. carrot
   D. bread

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Say the three time words heute, morgen and gestern in English and give one German sentence with one of them. (3 marks)

17. Write these numbers in German: 2, 6, 10. (3 marks)

18. Write a short weather report in German with a greeting, weather and a goodbye. (4 marks)

19. Write the German words with der, die or das for: face, father. (2 marks)

20. Read: "Heute ist Samstag. Vater liest im Wohnzimmer. Mutter kocht in der Küche." Give the gist. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — sky
   der Himmel means sky.

2. A — der
   in der Küche is correct.

3. B — onion
   die Zwiebel means onion.

4. A — water
   das Wasser means water.

5. A — bin
   ich goes with bin.

6. A — der
   It is der Schrank, so the little word is der.

7. D — goodbye
   Auf Wiedersehen means goodbye.

8. B — sind
   wir goes with sind.

9. D — September
   September in German is September.

10. D — die Wolken
   The plural of die Wolke is die Wolken.

11. D — sind
   Äpfel is plural, so we use sind.

12. D — der Freitag
   Friday in German is der Freitag.

13. B — Freitag
   After Donnerstag comes Freitag.

14. B — like y
   German j sounds like the English y.

15. A — cheese
   der Käse means cheese.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: heute = today, morgen = tomorrow, gestern = yesterday. For example: Heute ist Montag.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the three meanings, 1 mark for a correct sentence, 1 mark for capital letters.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: zwei, sechs, zehn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled number.

18. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example: Guten Morgen! Heute ist es sonnig und warm. Es ist nicht windig. Tschüss!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the greeting, 1 mark for weather sentences, 1 mark for spelling, 1 mark for the goodbye.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: das Gesicht, der Vater.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: It is Saturday. Father is reading in the living room and Mother is cooking in the kitchen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of the three facts.
